Why we adore it

Ten reasons WordPress still wins

Not nostalgia — substance. Here's the genuine, specific case, the same case we'd make to a friend starting something new today.

Blocks make publishing joyful

Headings, galleries, columns, embeds, buttons — drop them in, rearrange, done. The editor gets out of your way so the words and design come first.

Gutenberg

You actually own your content

Your posts, media, and data live in a database you control. Export everything in a click. No platform can lock you out, change the rules, or hold your audience hostage.

Ownership

Open source & GPL-licensed

The code is free, forkable, and accountable to no one shareholder. A global community improves it in the open. That's not just ethics — it's resilience.

Freedom 0–3

An ecosystem of everything

Tens of thousands of plugins and themes. WooCommerce for stores, membership, forms, SEO, backups — whatever you dream up, someone has likely already built a building block for it.

Extensible

It'll still work in 10 years

WordPress treats backward compatibility as sacred. A site you build today will keep running — your shortcodes, your URLs, your content — long after the trend cycle has moved on.

Longevity

SEO & performance maturity

Two decades of tuning means clean markup, semantic templates, image optimization, caching, and best-in-class SEO plugins. Search engines understand WordPress sites beautifully.

Mature

The open web wasn't a phase. It was a promise — that anyone, anywhere, could publish, own their voice, and never need anyone's permission to be heard. WordPress kept that promise, and keeps it still.

From the community

People who build with it, love it

Honest answers

But… isn't WordPress old? Isn't AI replacing all this?

Quite the opposite. WordPress has a clean REST API, a structured block model, and an emerging MCP/automation story that make it one of the most AI-friendly platforms there is. AI assistants can read your content, draft posts, generate patterns, and build pages against a stable, well-documented foundation. See the full AI case →
AI is fantastic at drafting. But you still need somewhere durable to own, edit, publish, and grow that content over years — with your domain, your SEO, your data, and your control. WordPress is exactly that home. AI fills the canvas faster; WordPress makes sure the canvas is yours.
It's genuinely approachable. Type to write, press / to insert any block, drag to rearrange. Patterns give you whole pre-designed sections in one click, and block themes let you restyle your entire site visually — no code required. Try the demo above; that's the real spirit of it.
No. Millions of people run beautiful WordPress sites without writing a line of code. And if you are a developer, you'll find a deep, open, hookable platform underneath — APIs, blocks you can author, and a design system in theme.json. It scales with your ambition.
You can export every post, page, and media file in standard formats whenever you like, and move your whole site between hosts in an afternoon. That portability is the entire point. WordPress earns your loyalty rather than trapping it.

Come to the block party.

Own your words. Build with joy. Stay free. Whether you're starting a blog, a shop, or a movement — WordPress is ready, and so are we.
